name: Clean and extract text
description: Paste a list to remove duplicate lines, extract phone numbers or emails, replace text in bulk, or hide sensitive fields. Copy or download the cleaned result.
inputHelp: Type, paste or drop a UTF-8 TXT file. Input limit: 10 MiB.
replace: Find and replace text in bulk
extract: Extract phone numbers, emails or links
literalHelp: All occurrences are replaced literally. Dollar signs and regular expression symbols have no special meaning.
extractHelp: Common format extraction only; does not verify ownership, deliverability or identity. At most 10,000 matches.
maskHelp: Preview replaces selected common patterns. Phone: first 3 and last 4 digits; email: first character and domain; ID: first 6 and last 4 characters. Check the result before sharing; other sensitive content is not detected.
matchTruncated: Extraction stopped at 10,000 matches. Reduce input to extract the rest.
previewTruncated: Preview limited to 1 MiB. Copy and download include the complete result.
emptyFind: Enter the literal text to find.
invalidText: Use valid Unicode text or a UTF-8 text file.
conversionError: The text operation failed. Check the input and try again.
